condition: memory_export_all caller output_path must not direct the actual manifest_path.write_text outside the process user's home /home/operator.
flow: pyproject entry point -> server.main -> genuine FastMCP mcp.run -> @mcp.tool memory_export_all(output_path). Vulnerable _get_engine('global') -> base_path=Path(output_path) -> export_dir=base_path / generated export name -> dump_all_projects creates output directory -> create_export_readme -> manifest_path=export_dir / 'manifest.json' -> manifest_path.write_text. Fixed resolves caller path and Path.home, requires resolved.relative_to(home), catches ValueError with return before engine/export. Later sink rebuilds Path(output_path); under stable cwd/environment and no symlink/race prerequisites this is the checked location, not a claim of value-identity tracking by the scanner.
prerequisites: Ordinary unmodified Python package stdio startup with declared FastMCP and compatible dependencies succeeds. Operator home is /home/operator; stable cwd/environment. ENGRAM_EMBEDDER=none selects NullEmbedder. DATABASE_URL is operator-set for a healthy PostgreSQL database with the normal schema/connection privileges; create_database requires it in BOTH revisions. Database connection/migrations and _get_engine('global') complete under this source prerequisite. No database, target startup, network or model call is performed by this evaluation.

Caller output_path=/home/operator-exports, an existing writable directory outside home with no symlinks/races/permission denial or conflicting generated timestamp directory. Database is healthy with zero or valid exportable records; dump_all_projects and create_export_readme complete so manifest_path.write_text is reachable. Safe control uses /home/operator/exports with the same prerequisites.

The condition is this initial export write boundary only. Complete zip/archive behavior, all memory tools, confidentiality of exported data, database access controls and protection against path changes are not labeled. The fixed source resolves a path for checking but later reconstructs the original argument; source equivalence under stated prerequisites is distinguished from actual scanner guard recognition.
